Cytokines
Serum or joint fluid proteins 
tested from venous blood. They 
include lymphocytes, (T & B 
cells), monocytes, leukocytes 
(interleukins), eosinophils, inter-
feron and growth factors. (See 
Chapter 3)
A group of immune reactant pro-
teins that have many functions 
even from one cell to another. 
They respond to the environmen-
tal influences to communicate and 
orchestrate the immune response 
to protect from cancer, infection 
and inflammation.
Cytokine examples:
Interleukins: IL-1,IL-6, 
IL-8, IL-10, TNF-a,
